source.title: Town of Riverhead Gross Earnings reports

note: Actual paid earnings (including overtime) by employee and year. The Town's export only carries department, title, and pay class from 2022 onward; for 2018-2021 a title comes from the Board's January salary resolution for that year where the person is on it, otherwise from the same person's one unchanging value in later years; both are flagged in "i".

fields.k: [longevity, holiday/differential, stipends, buy-outs, retro] breakdown of other pay
fields.i: fields not in this year's export: lower case carried back from the same person's other years (d=department, t=title, c=pay class, u=union); upper case taken from the Board's January salary resolution for the year (T=title, D=department, from the schedule's pay group)
